appName.message: Korean Word Lookup — Korean to English Translator & Dictionary

appDesc.message: Translate Korean to English instantly: hover words or select sentences. Google Translate + official KRDICT dictionary.

apiKeyHelper.message: No key is included. Your key is saved in Chrome sync storage.

statusHover.message: Hover over Korean text to see English definitions

reviewText.message: Tell other Korean learners how the extension works for you.

footerData.message: Dictionary data provided by National Institute of Korean Language's Basic Korean Dictionary

footerLicense.message: The extension source code is distributed under the MIT License

footerContact.message: If you have any suggestions or problems, please contact:

errorMissingKey.message: Dictionary API key missing. Set it in the popup.

optAutoFallbackDesc.message: Automatically try another source if not found

welcomeSubtitle.message: Thank you for installing Korean Word Lookup. Here's how to get started.

refreshNotice.message: Refresh tabs that were already open before you installed or updated the extension.

feat1.message: Hover over Korean words to see their English translations or definitions

feat2.message: Choose between Google Translate and Korean Dictionary

featAutoFallback.message: Auto-Fallback: Automatically switches to Google Translate if dictionary lookup fails

feat5.message: Use keyboard shortcuts for quick access to features

feat6.message: Customize hover delay, tooltip size, and definition depth from the popup

feat7.message: Select Korean sentences to translate them instantly

start1.message: Click the extension icon in your browser toolbar

start2.message: Pin the extension to see whether extension is enabled

start3.message: Make sure translation is enabled (toggle switch is on)

start5.message: Hover over any Korean text to see its translation!

credits1.message: This extension uses two translation sources:

credits3.message: Provided by National Institute of Korean Language's Basic Korean Dictionary

credits4.message: Offers detailed word definitions and examples

quickStartEnable.message: Open the extension icon, turn on word translation, and select Google Translate.

quickStartOpen.message: Open the Korean Wikipedia test page with the button below.

quickStartHover.message: Hover over a Korean word on that page to see its English meaning.

quickStartSelection.message: For sentences, enable selection translation in the popup, then highlight Korean text.

sourceKeyNotice.message: Google Translate works without an API key. Korean Dictionary (KRDICT) requires your own key.

demoDisclaimer.message: This is a saved example, not a live translation. Use the test page above to try real lookups.

demoHint.message: Hover, focus, or click the highlighted word to show the example.

supportedPagesHint.message: Use regular webpages. Chrome internal pages, the Chrome Web Store, and Chrome's PDF viewer are not supported.

macShortcutTip.message: Mac: If shortcuts conflict, use Manage shortcuts to set ⌥⇧T / ⌥⇧G / ⌥⇧K / ⌥⇧S.

selectionNudgeTitle.message: Quick tip: turn on sentence translation

selectionNudgeText.message: Enable selection translation to translate Korean sentences you highlight.
